text: Setting clear project goals is essential for success. One useful method is using SMART goals, which are specific, measurable, achievable, relevant, and time-bound. This approach helps teams stay focused and track their progress. It is also important to define milestones, which are key points in the project timeline, and deliverables, the concrete results you promise to produce. Finally, stakeholder alignment matters a lot. Everyone involved should understand and agree on the goals from the start. When all these elements work together, projects run more smoothly and are more likely to meet everyone's expectations.
